findings.title: Deeply nested ternary operator - critical maintainability issue
findings.description: Lines 785-814 contain a deeply nested ternary operator (13+ levels deep) for determining cursor class names. This is extremely difficult to read, debug, and maintain. The cursor logic spans 30 lines of nested conditionals which violates clean code principles.

findings.title: Missing canvas cleanup - potential memory leak
findings.description: The prepareForOutpainting function creates two canvas elements (compositeCanvas and maskCanvas) but never cleans them up. For repeated calls, this could cause memory pressure. Canvas elements hold significant memory that should be explicitly released.

findings.title: Missing edge case validation for zero-dimension images
findings.description: The prepareForOutpainting function doesn't validate that img.width and img.height are greater than zero before calculating scale. If a corrupt or invalid image loads with 0x0 dimensions, this would cause scale to be Infinity or NaN, leading to unexpected behavior.

findings.title: Silent error handling - no user feedback on failure
findings.description: The Face Enhance button's onClick handler catches errors and logs them to console, but provides no user-visible feedback about the failure. Users will see the button return to normal state with no indication of why the operation failed.

findings.title: Missing input validation in outpaint method
findings.description: The outpaint method accepts image, prompt, and direction parameters but performs no validation. Empty strings or null values could be passed to the backend, causing errors that would be harder to debug.

findings.title: Missing useEffect cleanup - potential React warning
findings.description: The useEffect hook creates an Image object and sets up event handlers but doesn't clean them up on unmount. If the component unmounts while an image is loading, the onload callback could fire and try to update state, causing React warnings.
